1.
The present DAR has been filed on behalf of petitioner against respondents for grant of compensation in respect of death of Rahul Bhatia, caused in a road traffic accident on 29.11.2016.

2. The brief facts in narrow compass, relevant and necessary for the disposal of the present petition are that on 29.11.2016 after attending the ring ceremony of one Mr. Komal at Punjabi Bagh West,
Rahul (now deceased) along with his friends were traveling on scooty no. DL-4SCJ-9799 (hereinafter referred as offending vehicle) as pillion rider and was coming to his house.
The scooty was being driven by one of his friend namely respondent no. 1-Aman Ajmani.

At about 01.50 AM in the night Sh. Aman took a fast sharp turn in a rash and negligent manner from the side of Najafgarh Road towards Pankha Road and hit the scooty against a car registration bearing no.
DL-9CAL-0989 which was going ahead of it.

Due to the forceful impact, both the riders of scooty fell down and Rahul sustained multiple dangerous injuries and was removed to DDU hospital by the PCR and during the treatment, deceased expired on 08.12.2016 and his postmortem was conducted by doctors of DDU hospital.
It is also stated that an FIR No.672/16 U/s 279/304A IPC, P.S.-Janak Puri was registered.
It is also stated that at the time of accident, deceased was only 19 years old and was doing private job and was getting salary about Rs.16,000/ per month.
It is also stated that all the petitioners were fully dependent upon the income of the deceased and he was unmarried.

It is also stated that due to the said accident, the petitioners have suffered great mental pain and agony, loss of future prospects loss of love and affection, loss of shelter, loss of income, pecuniary and nonpecuniary loss.
